fieldContext.note: Stakeholder conflicts should be resolved via consensus negotiation (Fisher & Ury 'Getting to Yes') or accommodated through Product Line Engineering (separating Invariant from Variant requirements).

personalNotes: Product Line Engineering: Design to Invariants for shared requirements across stakeholders, and Design for Change (customization points) for variant requirements (e.g. Celsius vs Fahrenheit display).
